name: Hidden Supply Cache
placementTarget: Rulebook, rule B, beside the stockpile chart
text:
HIDDEN SUPPLY CACHE

During setup, add the Supply cubes indicated to the right of the stockpile chart (in addition to those for the current month) to the stockpile.

mechanics.effect: During setup, add the Supply cubes shown to the right of the stockpile chart, in addition to the cubes for the current month.
restrictions: The chart amount is added on top of the month's supply
mechanics.notes: The letter B is the rulebook slot named in the manifest. It is not printed on the sticker. Area 10's +15 is one amount this rule adds.
